This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of temporary bail relating to FIR/Crime No.843/2021 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Mandsaur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 406, 409 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the M. P. Nikshepako Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000, on the ground of medical ailment and treatment of applicant.
